review_scope: One complete provider review of13 staged implementation/test/spec/report files,3 chunks/calls, no exclusions/skips/truncation. Raw evidence archives excluded; fourteen-file final internal review additionally covers the focused model-identity regression added after the provider call.

findings.reason: Generations are local to a model, but compatible(old,next) refuses a DataGrid model-pointer change before retained sync. mountGrid stores that descriptor model in the new binding, whose projectionReady starts false. No production path mutates r.node.Grid outside reconcile. Meaningful same-model source/viewport/selection/cursor changes advance generation; config is fixed, and private editing is synchronized independently. Thus distinct equal-generation models cannot reach the completed-projection reuse branch of the old binding.
findings.validation: Actual same-node-ID, distinct-model-pointer, equal-generation reconciliation remounts, materializes second-source cells, retires old binding/registration and retains one canonical child. The separate new regression passes race×3. No production or provider-reviewed source/spec/report changed after review.
